label: Vice President
description: Vice-president titles not assigned to a more specific C-suite role.

label: Program Director
description: Program Director, Director of Programs, and directors of named program portfolios.

label: Managing Director
description: Managing Director titles, excluding assistant and hybrid C-suite titles.

label: COO
description: Chief Operating Officer and standard COO aliases.

label: Senior Vice President
description: Senior Vice President, SVP, and Senior VP aliases.

label: Development / Fundraising Director
description: Director-level development, fundraising, philanthropy, and advancement roles.

label: Policy / Advocacy Director
description: Director-level policy, advocacy, legislative, and government-affairs roles.

label: Communications / Public Affairs Director
description: Director-level communications, editorial, marketing, and public-affairs roles.

label: Senior Researcher / Fellow / Analyst
description: Senior or principal researchers, fellows, scientists, economists, and analysts without a director or executive title.

label: CFO
description: Chief Financial Officer and standard CFO aliases.

label: General Counsel / CLO
description: General Counsel and Chief Legal Officer, excluding associate, deputy, and assistant counsel.

label: Chief of Staff
description: Chief of Staff, excluding Deputy Chief of Staff and multi-role COO hybrids.

label: Research Director
description: Director-level research roles, including Directors of Research.

label: Finance Director
description: Director-level finance roles, including Director of Finance and Finance Director.

label: Deputy Director
description: Deputy Director titles, excluding deputy vice presidents and deputy functional posts.

label: Executive Vice President
description: Executive Vice President, EVP, and Executive VP aliases.

label: Chief Development Officer
description: Chief Development, Philanthropy, or Advancement Officer titles.

label: Chief People Officer
description: Chief People, Human Resources, Human Capital, and People-and-Culture Officer titles.

label: Chief Economist
description: Chief Economist titles; retained internally until the public sample is large enough.

label: Chief Research Officer
description: Chief Research Officer titles; not pooled with Chief Scientist or Chief Economist.

label: Chief Scientist
description: Chief Scientist titles; not pooled with other research chiefs.

label: CTO
description: Chief Technology Officer and CTO aliases.

label: CIO
description: Chief Information Officer and CIO aliases.

label: Chief Program Officer
description: Chief Program or Chief Programs Officer titles.

label: Chief Impact Officer
description: Chief Impact Officer titles.

label: Chief Communications Officer
description: Chief Communications and Chief Marketing Officer titles.

label: Chief Strategy Officer
description: Chief Strategy and Chief Innovation Officer titles.

label: Controller
description: Controller titles, kept separate from Finance Director.

label: Deputy Chief of Staff
description: Deputy Chief of Staff, kept separate from Chief of Staff.

label: Assistant Managing Director
description: Assistant Managing Director, kept separate from Managing Director.
